sentences.text: Before
Hon'Ble
Shri Justice Subodh Abhyankar

On The 15 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 27186 of 2024
 Om Sakte
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 (Shri Santosh Kumar Meena- Advocate For The Applicant)
(SHRI TARUN PAGARE - P.L./G.A. FOR THE STATE AND SHRI YOGESH  KUMAR GUPTA- ADVOCATE FOR THE OBJECTOR)
ORDER 1] They are heard.
Perused the case-diary.

2] This is the applicant's first application under Section 438 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.103/2024 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3] The allegation against the applicant is of rape on the pretext of marriage.
4] Counsel for the applicant has submitted that the FIR in the present case has been lodged on 25.06.2024, in respect of the incident which took place between 25.03.2021 to 23.06.2024.

It is submitted that the prosecutrix was major and was a consenting party, which is also apparent from the FIR itself, as the prosecutrix was in an intimate relationship with the applicant for more than 2- 3 years.

5] Counsel for the objector, on the other hand, has opposed the prayer 2 MCRC-27186-2024 and it is submitted that the prosecutrix was minor at the time of the incident and otherwise also, when she was leaving the place where the accused was residing, the accused also stopped her at that time and again took her to a hotel where he committed rape on her, but refused to marry her, which led the prosecutrix to lodge the FIR, and in such circumstances, the custodial interrogation of the applicant would be necessary.

vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/95286180/
1
6] Counsel for the State has also opposed the prayer.

7] Having considered the rival submissions and on perusal of the case diary and looking to the fact that the age of the prosecutrix is also disputed and further considering the fact that she was in a relationship with the applicant for more than 2-3 years, this Court is of the considered opinion that under the facts and circumstances of the case,
custodial interrogation of the applicant is not necessary.
8] Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail, upon his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (rupees twenty five thousand only) and furnishing one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by a Police Officer, as and when required.
He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in Sub Section (2) of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
Certified copy as per rules.
